title: Embedded OLE object ods 001
notes: legacy OLE embed in ODF, spread-sheet placement: real binary part object.bin (hand-built minimal CFB v3 stub, shared _ole_cfb_stub helper, manifest media-type application/x-ole-object, package-root href) referenced by draw:frame > draw:object (draw:mime-type + draw:object-type "application/oleobject", xlink show=embed actuate=onLoad, svg 5cm x 5cm) placed inside a table:table-cell text:p with text:anchor-type="as-char" — the in-cell frame slot LibreOffice itself uses for cell-anchored media; the cell keeps a plain-text label run next to the frame so its text survives even if the object is dropped. Placement decision, stated honestly: cell-hosted draw frames are the LO on-disk shape for images in ODS, but ODF 1.2's cell content grammar for frames is thin — embed reachability varies by reader and LibreOffice is not run here, so downstream tests must treat the frame as pass-through content (never text truth). The CFB stub carries no payload streams, so an icon placeholder or nothing may render. The normative counters read table:table=1 and draw:frame=1. Reference text covers only the four visible cell strings.
